reviews.review_title: bring back OG Lethal Ape Redux (Plz)
reviews.review_description:
I honestly agree with a lot of the recent reviews. When OG Redux came back, it actually felt like something people thought was gone forever was actually back! Seeing people get excited over it again was really cool.

Yeah, the lobbies weren't always full, but I don't think that was the point. People weren't playing it because it was the biggest game out there. They were playing it because it was OG Lethal Ape Redux. It had history, memories, and a lot of people just wanted to experience it again.

That's why I agree with the people asking for it back. I downloaded it because it was OG Lethal Ape Redux too. It sucks that it was only back for a little while before it disappeared again...

I really hope you guys bring it back someday. Even if it wasn't the most active game, there were still a lot of people who cared about it, and I think it deserves to stay around instead of becoming lost media all over again.
